messages:
Alex: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Alex: Yesterday: landed gw PR for header-preserve, added tests for route weight fallback.
Alex: Blockers: still seeing 500s when `x-rw-auth` header is missing in staging, need help reproducing.
Maria: I can repro locally, sending docker-compose snippet in a min. Not a flake.
Jordan: Yesterday: updated rate-limiter to expose per-route metrics.
Jordan: Blocker: can't map token bucket per-client when route has `dynamic-prefix` rewriting; 429s spike in canary.
Sam: Today: will pair w/ Jordan to add a tag for rewritten routes so rl-plugin can key correctly.
Priya: FYI I tweaked routing policy on canary: `policy: allow, rate_limit: 200r/s` — monitor metrics.
Alex: @Sam please link the CR. Also @Maria can you paste the repro steps?
Maria: Repro steps: curl -H 'x-rw-auth: userA' -X POST https://staging-gw/redwood/api --data @payload.json
Maria: payload.json is small (100 tokens). If header omitted, stacktrace in logs: `panic: nil pointer` at router/route.go:214
Jordan: I added a quick log filter: `kubectl logs -f gw-canary | grep auth ->` shows missing header branch. Need a guard.
Sam: CR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/pull/2412 — adds rewritten-route tag + tests
Alex: LGTM pending unit test tweak. Can someone add a smoke to canary pipeline to POST without header and assert 401 not 500?
deploy-bot: started pipeline gw-canary/smoke-2026-03-18 at ci/2026-03-18T09:12Z
Priya: I'll add the smoke, linking ticket #PLAT-892.
Maria: On code review: also small nits on `route.go` — prefer `if header==""` guard before deref.
Jordan: Agree, will push patch.
Sam: Also bumped rate limiter config in staging to 250r/s for low traffic windows.
Alex: Thanks. Last thing — can we freeze any routing-policy changes till 4pm PST? Oncall plan to monitor.
Priya: Ack. I'll queue changes for after 4pm unless urgent.
Jordan: pairing at 11:00 PT in #dev-call if anyone wants to join.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll follow up in this thread with post-smoke results.
Maria: post-smoke: 2026-03-18T10:03Z — smoke shows 401 for missing header, 200 for auth header. :thumbsup:
Alex: Great, closing blocker. I'll merge the CR after unit test tweak.
deploy-bot: deploy gw-canary v1.12.3 -> started at ci/2026-03-18T10:20Z
Sam: Heads-up: please watch token bucket metrics (route.rates.bucket) — spike expected while auth fix rolls out.
